sources.snippet: Qwen-3.8-Flash-Next was released under the Qwen Community License 1.0, which permits both commercial and non-commercial use of the model weights subject to the terms published alongside the checkpoint on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

sources.title: Alibaba's Qwen Team Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A 125B Multimodal MoE ...
sources.snippet: Alibaba’s Qwen team has released Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, an open-weight multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model built for cost per token. The checkpoint pairs a 125B backbone with a 51B N-gram embedding table and a 4B multi-token prediction module. Only 6B parameters activate per token.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next · GSQ-RCO-abliterated IQ3_S — prebuilt Strata pack
sources.snippet: SC117/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-abliterated-GGUF is already a Strata-ready GGUF, but Strata still needs a pack (dense tensors + tensor index + tokenizer) built from it — and that step is exactly where people get stuck.
